posts.text: me as an aries: apologizing loudly while still being right
posts.caption: the loudest sorry you'll ever get, and zero backing down. tag your aries.

posts.text: me as a taurus: i'm not stubborn, i'm just right forever

posts.text: taurus rising: looks calm, already decided, not moving an inch

posts.text: me as a gemini: "quick story" and it's forty minutes later

posts.text: gemini rising and i made a best friend in the bathroom line

posts.text: me as a cancer: "i'm fine" with tears already loading

posts.text: cancer be like "text me when you get home" every single time

posts.text: date a cancer they said. now my mom likes them more

posts.text: leo moon so if you forget to hype me, i'm noticing

posts.text: me as a libra: "i don't mind, you pick" then minding

posts.text: me as a scorpio: "i'm over it" (i will never be over it)

posts.text: venus in scorpio: loyal for life, or a stranger by friday
